integrity: All mathematical conclusions are accompanied by an analytic proof and finite independent linear-algebra sanity tests; no external or independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only radially stretched regular-simplex directions; no statement about arbitrary simplices, mesh-wide well-centeredness, or the minimum enclosing ball. General circumcenter formulas subsume the algebraic coordinate calculation; the distinct claim is the sharp fixed-ratio coordinate bound and signed-coordinate structure. A potentially relevant 2010 dissertation was not available in full, so historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp circumcenter sign and barycentric-margin laws for radially stretched regular simplices
